freshness_boundary.permitted_claim: real-system external feasibility/falsification bridge for an M-only finite BAM subfamily

source.title: Barriers decouple population dynamics of riverine fish, and asynchrony of subpopulations promotes stability within fragments
source.reason_for_excluding_all_data_synchrony: its site-pair roster and synchrony columns arise from response-dependent temporal/positive-density filtering in the published analysis; primary M geometry must be derived only from rawdf site coordinates, river IDs and frozen fragment IDs

response_independent_analysis_window.reason: README reports 90 percent of sampling occasions occurred after 1988; use two equal 17-year calendar blocks without reading density values

A.reason: rawdf does not contain a frozen independent abiotic-habitat panel suitable for a defensible A constraint

B.reason: no predeclared causal biotic interaction variable is available in the raw time-series table

M.site_registry_rule: a physical site must map to one riverID and one unique_frag across all rows; drift is terminal_stop
M.coordinate_system_context: RT90 coordinates as documented by README
M.distance: Euclidean distance in released XKOORLOK/YKOORLOK coordinates
M.threshold_population: all unordered distinct physical-site pairs within the same riverID, independent of fish density
M.closed_edge_rule: same riverID, Euclidean distance <= frozen threshold, and same unique_frag
M.open_edge_rule: same riverID and Euclidean distance <= frozen threshold regardless of unique_frag
M.open_all_rule: all physical sites within the same riverID are mutually connected
M.calibration_sources: all calibration-positive physical sites for the species
M.reachability_semantics: undirected graph reachability from calibration sources with no additional graph-step horizon
M.barrier_effect_claim: world labels encode alternative connectivity assumptions only; survivor contraction is not a causal dam-effect estimate

raw_csv_schema.density_rule: numeric >=0 or missing; missing is unknown and never a positive or hard absence

evidence_contract.zero_semantics: recorded zero density is not used as a hard ecological absence
evidence_contract.calibration_eligibility: species retained in cohort; bridge is estimable only if it has at least two distinct calibration-positive physical sites
evidence_contract.calibration_world_invariant: every estimable species must retain all 9 M worlds because calibration positives are movement sources; violation is implementation_stop
evidence_contract.heldout_endpoint: a frozen M world is falsified for that species if a heldout positive site is not graph-reachable from any calibration-positive source

primary_outputs: per-heldout-positive number/fraction of the 9 worlds falsified
barrier-closed versus barrier-open attribution of eliminated worlds
secondary_outputs: species retaining multiple M worlds after all heldout positives
world-level number of species surviving heldout evidence
distribution of heldout witness elimination fractions
gates: Gate0 Dryad metadata identity: DOI/title/file roster; freeze file IDs/checksums/sizes; zero data payload bytes
Gate1 documentation-only README schema confirmation; zero rawdf bytes
Gate2 freeze exact CSV parser, M constructor, output schema and once-only execution contract
Gate3 once-only open rawdf.csv, validate exact physical schema, construct M worlds from geometry/fragment columns, then evaluate calibration and heldout positives without retuning
hard_stops: do not use all_data_synchrony.csv in primary bridge world construction
do not alter the 1988-2004 / 2005-2021 split after payload access
do not add or remove species after payload access
do not change distance thresholds or barrier/open semantics after payload access
do not reinterpret zeros as biological absence
do not repair physical CSV schema after response payload opening
do not call this fresh or independent confirmatory evidence
success_definition: success means the three predeclared species can be evaluated under the frozen 9-world M family and later positive observations either preserve or falsify worlds without post-response retuning; favorable contraction is not required
